title: A City of Many Cultures
text:
Our city has people from many countries. Each family brings its own food, music, and language. In our school, students speak more than ten languages. This makes the school a very interesting place.

Cultural diversity means that people are different in many ways. Some families celebrate holidays that others do not know. Learning about these holidays helps people understand each other. For example, the Chinese New Year festival is a happy time for many families.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, how many languages do students speak in the school?
According to paragraph two, what does learning about holidays help people do?
What can you infer about the writer's opinion of cultural diversity?
options: The writer thinks it is a problem for cities
The writer thinks it makes a school interesting
The writer thinks families should not share food
The writer thinks only one language is needed

questions.text: Why might a family celebrate holidays that other people do not know?
options: They do not have a calendar
They want to hide their holidays
Their traditions come from a different culture

vocabulary.definition: the fact that people are different from each other
making you want to learn more
to do something special for a happy day

paragraph_translations: Nuestra ciudad tiene personas de muchos países. Cada familia trae su propia comida, música e idioma. En nuestra escuela, los estudiantes hablan más de diez idiomas. Esto hace que la escuela sea un lugar muy interesante.

La diversidad cultural significa que las personas son diferentes en muchos aspectos. Algunas familias celebran festividades que otros no conocen. Aprender sobre estas festividades ayuda a las personas a entenderse unas a otras. Por ejemplo, el Año Nuevo chino es una época feliz para muchas familias.
